summary: Very steep bush-edge kerb with a house 11m away and no room to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto dense bush, but houses sit 11m and 15m south of the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: The sealed road bends away at the start; past it the line runs into trees with no visible road or pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet hillside road bend; a car passes in the imagery.
drivers.convention: No parked cars or campers seen.

flags: Steep: 16.9% mean, 31% max, well over the 12% limit
House within 10 to 15m of the start
Mapped line does not match the visible road past the bend
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over most of the line, shaded from the east.
cannot_judge: Whether a track continues into the bush
